description:
Found by Elixir Parity while building fz-mue.12, 2026-11-20.

Expected (Elixir): prints 1.
Actual: interp says "backend value 3 is unbound"; run says "native executable lowering failed" (artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan).

Repro:
```elixir
defmodule Main do
  def c(flag) do
    default = if flag, do: {:a, 1}, else: {:k}
    f = fn r ->
      case default do
        {:k} -> r
        d -> d
      end
    end
    f.(1)
  end
  def main() do
    IO.inspect(c(length(System.argv()) > 5))
  end
end
Main.main()
```

Done when this program prints 1 on all three paths, as a fixture.

Folded in (user decision, 2026-11-25; proposed by Bugs and Cleanup): whether a closure call goes through the apply seam has one answer. Today two predicates answer that one question. The demand pass marks a closure call opaque with exact_local_target (runtime_demand.rs ~2667, closure_callee_demand). Transport picks Seam with CallSiteSummary::single_owned_target (transport.rs:872-879, closure_call_form). That split is how this bug happened: transport took the seam, and demand never asked for the seam's wrapper. The fix leaves one predicate, which both sites read. Findings: B&C scratchpad s256/findings.md; plan: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.256.html.
title: A closure that captures a union-valued variable and cases on it fails
